query:
INSERT INTO organization_invitations (
            organization_id,
            email,
            invited_role,
            invitation_type,
            status,
            token_hash,
            invited_by_user_id,
            target_user_id
         )
         VALUES (
            $1,
            $2,
            $3::user_role,
            $4::invitation_type,
            'PENDING',
            $5,
            $6,
            $7
         )
         RETURNING id
